question: What catalyst loading, DMC:glycerol molar ratio, reaction temperature and reaction time were found optimal for glycerol carbonate synthesis?
expect: 3.45 wt% catalyst, 3.58:1 DMC:glycerol, 90 °C, 119 min (92.40% yield) (abstract; sec. 3)
trap: the 92.40% yield or 55.70 kJ/mol as a condition
rendered:
According to the document, the optimal conditions for glycerol carbonate synthesis were found to be:

* Catalyst loading: 3.45 wt%
* DMC:glycerol molar ratio: 3.58:1
* Reaction temperature: 90.20 °C
* Reaction time: 119 min

These conditions resulted in a predicted GyC yield of 94.77%, which was near the actual obtained experimental yield of 92.40%.
